en: Black‑and‑white street view labeled Viipuri, showing a cobbled avenue with tram tracks, pedestrians, and shopfronts with awnings. A vertical sign reads "PARTURI" and, in the distance, the large arched facade of the market hall is visible. The reverse has a divided back with Finnish–Swedish imprint, a penciled/inked catalog number, and the handwritten name "Hugo E. Liljestrand."
